items.question: What is Blockiva – Block Puzzle?
items.answer: Blockiva is a rotating-rules block puzzle for iOS. Place shapes, clear rows and columns, then survive the next rule. Free on the App Store (id6813509536). Google Play coming soon. Package: com.zuki.apps.blockiva.

items.question: Is this Block Blast?
items.answer: No. Blockiva is its own rotating-rules puzzle. We do not name competitors in ads.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. Scores and settings stay on your device.

items.question: What are the five rotating rules?
items.answer: Locked Tiles, Frozen Row, Shadow Blocks, Double Score, and Fake Block. A new rule appears every N turns.

items.question: What difficulties are available?
items.answer: Chill 10×10 (5 turns), Classic 8×8 (3 turns), Intense 7×7 (2 turns), and Chaos 6×6 (1 turn).

items.question: How do ads work?
items.answer: Free players may see a menu banner and an interstitial after game over, with a 2-minute cooldown. Remove Ads (blockiva_remove_ads) is a one-time purchase.

items.question: Is Blockiva free?
items.answer: Yes. Optional Remove Ads (blockiva_remove_ads, recommended USD $2.99) removes ads and unlocks extra shuffles and a continue. It is not a subscription.

items.question: How many shuffles do I get?
items.answer: One shuffle per game on Free. When nothing fits, the run ends. Premium adds extra shuffles and a continue.

items.question: Does Fake Block count toward clears?
items.answer: No. Fake Block does not count toward clears — do not try to complete a line with it.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Blockiva – Block Puzzle.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use Blockiva and related pages at zukiapps.com/blockiva.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the Blockiva app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: Blockiva is designed to work offline. We collect limited data to run the app and optional ads.
items: Scores, difficulty, language, and Premium status stored on device
Feedback and support messages you send
Advertising identifiers if you allow tracking (iOS App Tracking Transparency)
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Operate and improve Blockiva
Show ads to free players (Google AdMob)
Respond to support requests
Validate in-app purchases
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and tracking
section4.content: Free players may see Google AdMob banners and interstitials. On iOS we request tracking permission before personalized ads.
section4.content2: You can limit ad tracking in system settings. Premium removes ads.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Game progress remains on device until you uninstall.
section5.content2: Ad and purchase partners retain data under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Google AdMob (ads), Firebase (Crashlytics and Analytics), Apple App Store, and Google Play Billing may process data under their policies.
section6.content2: Crash reports are sent with Firebase Crashlytics in release builds.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: Blockiva is a general-audience puzzle game. It is not directed to children under 13.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

q1.question: How do I play?
q1.answer: Drag a shape onto the board (or tap to select, then tap a cell). Fill a full row or column to clear it. Use all three shapes to get a new set. Watch the rule chip.

q2.question: What does Shuffle do?
q2.answer: Shuffle replaces the unused pieces for the current game. Free players get 1 shuffle. Premium adds extra shuffles and a continue.

q3.question: How do I remove ads?
q3.answer: Buy Remove Ads (blockiva_remove_ads) in Settings. Recommended price USD $2.99, one-time. Use Restore purchases after reinstall.

q4.question: Where are my scores stored?
q4.answer: On your device. Uninstalling the app deletes local scores.

q5.question: What are the five rules?
q5.answer: Locked Tiles, Frozen Row, Shadow Blocks, Double Score, and Fake Block.

q6.question: What are the four difficulties?
q6.answer: Chill 10×10 / 5 turns, Classic 8×8 / 3 turns, Intense 7×7 / 2 turns, Chaos 6×6 / 1 turn.

q7.question: Is Remove Ads a subscription?
q7.answer: No. blockiva_remove_ads is a one-time in-app purchase.

q8.question: How do I contact support?
q8.answer: Email zuki.apps.dev@gmail.com. We typically respond within 24–48 hours.
